data.fullJobDescription: # MS SQL Server Developer (Azure, DevOps, GIT) **Full-time** **Location:** Fully Remote ## JOIN A TEAM THAT EMPOWERS YOU Eracent stands at the forefront of IT Asset Management (ITAM) and Software Asset Management (SAM) solutions, designed to help organizations optimize their IT assets, reduce costs, and ensure regulatory compliance. Our flagship product, ITPedia, serves as a comprehensive knowledge base, providing detailed information on millions of software and hardware products. As we continue to enhance our solutions with cloud and data-driven capabilities, we are seeking an experienced MS SQL Server Developer to join our growing team in India. In this position, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining SQL Server databases, supporting DevOps workflows, and integrating Azure-based solutions that drive our global data operations. ## ROLE PURPOSE As an MS SQL Server Developer, you will design and optimize SQL Server databases, ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability. You will collaborate with development and DevOps teams to implement CI CD pipelines, support cloud migrations, and ensure that data processes meet performance and security requirements. This role requires hands-on experience with SQL Server development, Azure, and Git-based version control systems. ## KEY FOCUS * Design, develop, and maintain SQL Server databases, stored procedures, functions, and triggers. * Optimize database performance through indexing strategies, query tuning, and refactoring. * Implement DevOps practices and CI CD pipelines for database deployment (Azure DevOps preferred) . * Collaborate with developers and data engineers to support data integration and transformation processes. * Administer Azure SQL Databases, configure backups, and monitor performance metrics. * Work with Git for version control and database change tracking. * Ensure data security, compliance, and high availability in production environments. * Participate in architecture reviews and propose improvements to database design and automation workflows. ## COMPETENCIES: * Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related technical field. * 5+ years of professional experience in SQL Server database development and optimization. * Advanced knowledge of T-SQL, indexing, query optimization, and schema design. * Experience with Azure SQL Database, Azure Data Services, or related cloud technologies. * Proficiency in DevOps CI CD tools (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar) . * Experience with Git-based workflows for version control. * Understanding of database backup, restore, and high-availability strategies. * Strong understanding of data modeling and relational design principles. * Good English communication skills, both written and spoken. ## EXPERIENCE, CAPABILITIES AND BEHAVIORS: **Must have professional technical qualifications** * Experience with Azure DevOps pipelines or GitHub Actions for database automation. * Familiarity with PowerShell or Python scripting for automation is a plus. * Understanding of data governance and security standards. * Microsoft certifications such as Azure Database Administrator Associate or Azure Data Engineer Associate are advantageous. * Experience with IT Asset Management (ITAM) or Software Asset Management (SAM) solutions is a plus. * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. * Excellent communication and teamwork abilities. * Self-motivated and able to work independently or collaboratively within a distributed team. * Adaptable to changing requirements and technologies. * Commitment to continuous learning and process improvement.

data.fullJobDescription: # Job Description: Figma Developer ## Position Overview We are seeking a Figma Developer with strong expertise in UI UX design and prototyping to join our team. The ideal candidate will translate business requirements into engaging, user-friendly designs using Figma and collaborate closely with developers. You will be responsible for creating pixel-perfect designs, interactive prototypes, design systems, and component libraries that align with our product vision. ## Key Responsibilities * Design responsive, user-centric interfaces for web and mobile applications using Figma. * Build and maintain design systems, reusable components, and style guides. * Translate wireframes, user stories, and business needs into high-fidelity mockups and prototypes. * Collaborate with frontend developers to ensure smooth handoff from design to code. * Conduct UX research, usability testing, and user journey mapping to validate design decisions. * Implement and manage version control in Figma for efficient teamwork. * Ensure consistency, accessibility, and scalability of all UI designs. * Stay updated on UI UX trends, Figma plugins, and best practices to improve workflows. ## Required Skills & Qualifications * Proven experience as a UI UX Designer, Figma Developer, or Frontend-focused Designer. * Strong portfolio showcasing expertise in Figma designs, prototypes, and component libraries. * Hands-on experience in designing responsive layouts for web & mobile. * Familiarity with frontend technologies (HTML, CSS, React, Angular, Flutter) . * Knowledge of UX best practices, accessibility standards, and design heuristics. * Ability to conduct user research and usability testing. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work with product managers, developers, and stakeholders. ## Nice to Have * Experience with motion design micro-interactions in Figma. * Knowledge of tools like Adobe XD, Sketch, or InVision. * Experience with multilingual & internationalization (i18n) design systems. * Familiarity with Agile Scrum methodologies. ## Education & Experience * Bachelor's degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Computer Science, or related field. * 2-5 years of experience in UI UX design, with strong expertise in Figma. ## Why Join Us? * Opportunity to work on cutting-edge applications with a user-first approach. * Collaborative team culture with design + development synergy. * Freedom to innovate and own design systems end-to-end. * Competitive compensation and growth opportunities.

**JOB DESCRIPTION TEXT:** New Position Location : Mumbai is first preference, Remote also works if Mumbai office doesn't work Working hours and time zones : 6 hours overlap with US EST time zone. This is a T & M engagement hence there would be daily calls with US Leads CTC budget for this position? Client is looking for resources between 4-10 years' experience. Hence CTC range can be Rs 1 Lacs per month (all inclusive) . Understanding US accent is critical to ensure success. Model : FTE AI Developer (Typescript Python) We're seeking a skilled AI Developer (TypeScript & Python) to join our AI squad. You will design, develop, and integrate RAG and conversational AI features into our TypeScript-based products, working closely with product teams to embed AI-driven solutions like chatbots and knowledge retrieval systems. This role emphasizes TypeScript for application development and integration, with Python experience as a strong plus to support model development and preprocessing in collaboration with the team. Responsibilities - Develop and deploy RAG systems to retrieve and generate contextually relevant responses using TypeScript and Node. js. - Build conversational AI features, such as chatbots and virtual assistants, integrated into our web and mobile applications. - Create and maintain TypeScript-based APIs (REST GraphQL) to serve AI outputs to product teams. - Integrate with vector databases (e. g., Pinecone, Weaviate) and cloud-based AI services (e. g., Hugging Face, AWS Bedrock) for RAG and conversational AI. - Use libraries like TensorFlow. js or ONNX. js for client-side or server-side AI inference. - Collaborate with team members to incorporate pre-trained models or embeddings into TypeScript applications, leveraging Python for model training or preprocessing when needed. - Work with product teams to embed AI features into React-based front-ends or Node. js back-ends. - Optimize AI features for performance, scalability, and user experience within our TypeScript ecosystem. - Contribute to reusable TypeScript components and SDKs for seamless AI integration across products. What We're Looking For - Experience: 4+ years of professional software development experience with TypeScript and JavaScript. - AI Knowledge: Familiarity with AI ML concepts, particularly NLP, chatbots, or RAG systems. - Technical Skills: - Proficiency in TypeScript, Node. js, and front-end frameworks (e. g., React NextJS) . - Experience with AI libraries like TensorFlow. js, ONNX. js, or similar for inference. - Knowledge of REST GraphQL APIs and integrating with cloud-based AI services (e. g., Hugging Face, AWS Bedrock) . - Familiarity with vector databases (e. g., Pinecone, Weaviate) or vector search libraries. - Python Experience (Strong Plus) : Knowledge of Python for AI ML tasks, such as model training, fine-tuning, or embedding generation using libraries like Hugging Face Transformers, SentenceTransformers, or PyTorch. - Collaboration: Ability to work with team members to integrate pre-trained models or embeddings into TypeScript applications. - Problem-Solving: Strong ability to design and implement scalable AI-driven features within a TypeScript stack. Nice to Have - Experience with conversational AI frameworks (e. g., Botpress, Rasa) or RAG pipelines (e. g., LangChain, LlamaIndex) . - Experience with React NextJS - Familiarity with exporting models to ONNX or TensorFlow. js formats. - Knowledge of cloud platforms (e. g., AWS, GCP) for AI deployment. Why Join Us - Be part of a focused AI squad driving innovation in RAG and conversational AI. - Work in a TypeScript-centric environment, with opportunities to leverage Python for advanced AI tasks. - Collaborate with cross-functional product teams to deliver impactful AI features. - Opportunity to grow in AI development with access to cutting-edge tools and cloud services. Essential Requirements - Fluency in business English (spoken and written) is required - Must have your own computer and a stable internet connection. - Must be able to pass a background check to qualify for this contractor role

Our flagship product, ITPedia, serves as a comprehensive knowledge base, providing detailed information on millions of software and hardware products. As we continue to enhance our solutions with cloud and data-driven capabilities, we are seeking an experienced MS SQL Server Developer to join our growing team in India. In this position, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining SQL Server databases, supporting DevOps workflows, and integrating Azure-based solutions that drive our global data operations. ROLE PURPOSE As an MS SQL Server Developer, you will design and optimize SQL Server databases, ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability. You will collaborate with development and DevOps teams to implement CI CD pipelines, support cloud migrations, and ensure that data processes meet performance and security requirements. This role requires hands-on experience with SQL Server development, Azure, and Git-based version control systems. ## KEY FOCUS * Design, develop, and maintain SQL Server databases, stored procedures, functions, and triggers. * Optimize database performance through indexing strategies, query tuning, and refactoring. * Implement DevOps practices and CI CD pipelines for database deployment (Azure DevOps preferred) . * Collaborate with developers and data engineers to support data integration and transformation processes. * Administer Azure SQL Databases, configure backups, and monitor performance metrics. * Work with Git for version control and database change tracking. * Ensure data security, compliance, and high availability in production environments. * Participate in architecture reviews and propose improvements to database design and automation workflows. ## COMPETENCIES: * Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related technical field. * 5+ years of professional experience in SQL Server database development and optimization. * Advanced knowledge of T-SQL, indexing, query optimization, and schema design. * Experience with Azure SQL Database, Azure Data Services, or related cloud technologies. * Proficiency in DevOps CI CD tools (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar) . * Experience with Git-based workflows for version control. * Understanding of database backup, restore, and high-availability strategies. * Strong understanding of data modeling and relational design principles. * Good English communication skills, both written and spoken. ## EXPERIENCE, CAPABILITIES AND BEHAVIORS: - Must have professional technical qualifications * Experience with Azure DevOps pipelines or GitHub Actions for database automation. * Familiarity with PowerShell or Python scripting for automation is a plus. * Understanding of data governance and security standards. * Microsoft certifications such as Azure Database Administrator Associate or Azure Data Engineer Associate are advantageous. * Experience with IT Asset Management (ITAM) or Software Asset Management (SAM) solutions is a plus. * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. * Excellent communication and teamwork abilities. * Self-motivated and able to work independently or collaboratively within a distributed team. * Adaptable to changing requirements and technologies. * Commitment to continuous learning and process improvement.

EXPERIENCE, CAPABILITIES AND BEHAVIORS: Must have professional technical qualifications * Experience with Azure DevOps pipelines or GitHub Actions for database automation. * Familiarity with PowerShell or Python scripting for automation is a plus. * Understanding of data governance and security standards. * Microsoft certifications such as Azure Database Administrator Associate or Azure Data Engineer Associate are advantageous. * Experience with IT Asset Management (ITAM) or Software Asset Management (SAM) solutions is a plus. * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. * Excellent communication and teamwork abilities. * Self-motivated and able to work independently or collaboratively within a distributed team. * Adaptable to changing requirements and technologies. * Commitment to continuous learning and process improvement.

Our flagship product, ITPedia?, serves as a comprehensive knowledge base, providing detailed information on millions of software and hardware products. As we continue to enhance our solutions with cloud and data-driven capabilities, we are seeking an experienced MS SQL Server Developer to join our growing team in India. In this position, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining SQL Server databases, supporting DevOps workflows, and integrating Azure-based solutions that drive our global data operations. ROLE PURPOSE As an MS SQL Server Developer, you will design and optimize SQL Server databases, ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability. You will collaborate with development and DevOps teams to implement CI CD pipelines, support cloud migrations, and ensure that data processes meet performance and security requirements. This role requires hands-on experience with SQL Server development, Azure, and Git-based version control systems. KEY FOCUS * Design, develop, and maintain SQL Server databases, stored procedures, functions, and triggers. * Optimize database performance through indexing strategies, query tuning, and refactoring. * Implement DevOps practices and CI CD pipelines for database deployment (Azure DevOps preferred) . * Collaborate with developers and data engineers to support data integration and transformation processes. * Administer Azure SQL Databases, configure backups, and monitor performance metrics. * Work with Git for version control and database change tracking. * Ensure data security, compliance, and high availability in production environments. * Participate in architecture reviews and propose improvements to database design and automation workflows. COMPETENCIES: * Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related technical field. * 5+ years of professional experience in SQL Server database development and optimization. * Advanced knowledge of T-SQL, indexing, query optimization, and schema design. * Experience with Azure SQL Database, Azure Data Services, or related cloud technologies. * Proficiency in DevOps CI CD tools (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar) . * Experience with Git-based workflows for version control. * Understanding of database backup, restore, and high-availability strategies. * Strong understanding of data modeling and relational design principles. * Good English communication skills, both written and spoken. EXPERIENCE, CAPABILITIES AND BEHAVIORS: Must have professional technical qualifications * Experience with Azure DevOps pipelines or GitHub Actions for database automation. * Familiarity with PowerShell or Python scripting for automation is a plus. * Understanding of data governance and security standards. * Microsoft certifications such as Azure Database Administrator Associate or Azure Data Engineer Associate are advantageous. * Experience with IT Asset Management (ITAM) or Software Asset Management (SAM) solutions is a plus. * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. * Excellent communication and teamwork abilities. * Self-motivated and able to work independently or collaboratively within a distributed team. * Adaptable to changing requirements and technologies. * Commitment to continuous learning and process improvement.

data.fullJobDescription: # MS SQL Server Developer (Azure, DevOps, GIT) **Full-time** **Location:** Fully Remote ## JOIN A TEAM THAT EMPOWERS YOU Eracent stands at the forefront of IT Asset Management (ITAM) and Software Asset Management (SAM) solutions, designed to help organizations optimize their IT assets, reduce costs, and ensure regulatory compliance. Our flagship product, ITPedia, serves as a comprehensive knowledge base, providing detailed information on millions of software and hardware products. As we continue to enhance our solutions with cloud and data-driven capabilities, we are seeking an experienced MS SQL Server Developer to join our growing team in India. In this position, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining SQL Server databases, supporting DevOps workflows, and integrating Azure-based solutions that drive our global data operations. ## ROLE PURPOSE As an MS SQL Server Developer, you will design and optimize SQL Server databases, ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability. You will collaborate with development and DevOps teams to implement CI CD pipelines, support cloud migrations, and ensure that data processes meet performance and security requirements. This role requires hands-on experience with SQL Server development, Azure, and Git-based version control systems. ## KEY FOCUS * Design, develop, and maintain SQL Server databases, stored procedures, functions, and triggers. * Optimize database performance through indexing strategies, query tuning, and refactoring. * Implement DevOps practices and CI CD pipelines for database deployment (Azure DevOps preferred) . * Collaborate with developers and data engineers to support data integration and transformation processes. * Administer Azure SQL Databases, configure backups, and monitor performance metrics. * Work with Git for version control and database change tracking. * Ensure data security, compliance, and high availability in production environments. * Participate in architecture reviews and propose improvements to database design and automation workflows. ## COMPETENCIES: * Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related technical field. * 5+ years of professional experience in SQL Server database development and optimization. * Advanced knowledge of T-SQL, indexing, query optimization, and schema design. * Experience with Azure SQL Database, Azure Data Services, or related cloud technologies. * Proficiency in DevOps CI CD tools (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar) . * Experience with Git-based workflows for version control. * Understanding of database backup, restore, and high-availability strategies. * Strong understanding of data modeling and relational design principles. * Good English communication skills, both written and spoken. ## EXPERIENCE, CAPABILITIES AND BEHAVIORS: Must have professional technical qualifications * Experience with Azure DevOps pipelines or GitHub Actions for database automation. * Familiarity with PowerShell or Python scripting for automation is a plus. * Understanding of data governance and security standards. * Microsoft certifications such as Azure Database Administrator Associate or Azure Data Engineer Associate are advantageous. * Experience with IT Asset Management (ITAM) or Software Asset Management (SAM) solutions is a plus. * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. * Excellent communication and teamwork abilities. * Self-motivated and able to work independently or collaboratively within a distributed team. * Adaptable to changing requirements and technologies. * Commitment to continuous learning and process improvement.

data.fullJobDescription: # Job Description: Figma Developer ## Position Overview We are seeking a Figma Developer with strong expertise in UI UX design and prototyping to join our team. The ideal candidate will translate business requirements into engaging, user-friendly designs using Figma and collaborate closely with developers. You will be responsible for creating pixel-perfect designs, interactive prototypes, design systems, and component libraries that align with our product vision. ## Key Responsibilities * Design responsive, user-centric interfaces for web and mobile applications using Figma. * Build and maintain design systems, reusable components, and style guides. * Translate wireframes, user stories, and business needs into high-fidelity mockups and prototypes. * Collaborate with frontend developers to ensure smooth handoff from design to code. * Conduct UX research, usability testing, and user journey mapping to validate design decisions. * Implement and manage version control in Figma for efficient teamwork. * Ensure consistency, accessibility, and scalability of all UI designs. * Stay updated on UI UX trends, Figma plugins, and best practices to improve workflows. ## Required Skills & Qualifications * Proven experience as a UI UX Designer, Figma Developer, or Frontend-focused Designer. * Strong portfolio showcasing expertise in Figma designs, prototypes, and component libraries. * Hands-on experience in designing responsive layouts for web & mobile. * Familiarity with frontend technologies (HTML, CSS, React, Angular, Flutter) . * Knowledge of UX best practices, accessibility standards, and design heuristics. * Ability to conduct user research and usability testing. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work with product managers, developers, and stakeholders. ## Nice to Have * Experience with motion design micro-interactions in Figma. * Knowledge of tools like Adobe XD, Sketch, or InVision. * Experience with multilingual & internationalization (i18n) design systems. * Familiarity with Agile Scrum methodologies. ## Education & Experience * Bachelor's degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Computer Science, or related field. * 2-5 years of experience in UI UX design, with strong expertise in Figma. ## Why Join Us? * Opportunity to work on cutting-edge applications with a user-first approach. * Collaborative team culture with design + development synergy. * Freedom to innovate and own design systems end-to-end. * Competitive compensation and growth opportunities.

This role requires hands-on experience with SQL Server development, Azure, and Git-based version control systems. ## KEY FOCUS * Design, develop, and maintain SQL Server databases, stored procedures, functions, and triggers. * Optimize database performance through indexing strategies, query tuning, and refactoring. * Implement DevOps practices and CI CD pipelines for database deployment (Azure DevOps preferred) . * Collaborate with developers and data engineers to support data integration and transformation processes. * Administer Azure SQL Databases, configure backups, and monitor performance metrics. * Work with Git for version control and database change tracking. * Ensure data security, compliance, and high availability in production environments. * Participate in architecture reviews and propose improvements to database design and automation workflows. ## COMPETENCIES: * Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related technical field. * 5+ years of professional experience in SQL Server database development and optimization. * Advanced knowledge of T-SQL, indexing, query optimization, and schema design. * Experience with Azure SQL Database, Azure Data Services, or related cloud technologies. * Proficiency in DevOps CI CD tools (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar) . * Experience with Git-based workflows for version control. * Understanding of database backup, restore, and high-availability strategies. * Strong understanding of data modeling and relational design principles. * Good English communication skills, both written and spoken. ## EXPERIENCE, CAPABILITIES AND BEHAVIORS: *Must have professional technical qualifications* * Experience with Azure DevOps pipelines or GitHub Actions for database automation. * Familiarity with PowerShell or Python scripting for automation is a plus. * Understanding of data governance and security standards. * Microsoft certifications such as Azure Database Administrator Associate or Azure Data Engineer Associate are advantageous. * Experience with IT Asset Management (ITAM) or Software Asset Management (SAM) solutions is a plus. * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. * Excellent communication and teamwork abilities. * Self-motivated and able to work independently or collaboratively within a distributed team. * Adaptable to changing requirements and technologies. * Commitment to continuous learning and process improvement.

data.fullJobDescription:
1. Position Overview The Music Director is responsible for leading, creating, and overseeing the musical direction of productions, recordings, performances, or musical organizations. This role combines artistic vision with technical expertise to ensure that music aligns with the creative, emotional, and commercial goals of the project or organization. A Music Director collaborates closely with producers, composers, artists, performers, sound engineers, and other creative professionals to deliver high-quality musical experiences. The role requires strong leadership, deep musical knowledge, and the ability to coordinate multiple musical elements such as composition, arrangement, orchestration, rehearsals, and live or recorded performances. The Music Director plays a key role in shaping the musical identity of a production, brand, or institution. They must balance creativity with logistical and operational responsibilities while maintaining high artistic standards.

2. Key Responsibilities

2. 1 Musical Leadership Define and establish the overall musical vision for productions, performances, recordings, or media projects. Lead musicians, vocalists, composers, and arrangers to deliver cohesive musical outcomes. Conduct rehearsals and guide performers in interpreting musical pieces. Maintain musical quality and artistic integrity throughout all stages of production.

2. 2 Composition and Arrangement Compose original music when required for performances, shows, films, advertisements, or other media. Arrange and adapt existing musical works to fit specific artistic requirements. Develop orchestration for bands, orchestras, ensembles, or digital productions. Ensure musical arrangements support the emotional and narrative elements of a project.

2. 3 Production Oversight Oversee recording sessions and ensure optimal sound quality. Work with sound engineers and producers to refine recordings and mixes. Review and approve final musical outputs before release or performance. Ensure technical aspects such as timing, instrumentation, and synchronization are accurate.

2. 4 Collaboration with Creative Teams Collaborate with directors, producers, choreographers, and writers to integrate music seamlessly into productions. Participate in creative meetings to align musical direction with overall project goals. Provide expert recommendations on musical styles, instrumentation, and performance approaches.

2. 5 Rehearsal Management Plan and organize rehearsal schedules. Provide constructive feedback to musicians and performers. Ensure performers understand musical timing, dynamics, and stylistic interpretation. Resolve musical challenges during rehearsals and performances.

2. 6 Talent Development Identify and recruit talented musicians and vocalists. Mentor and coach performers to improve musical performance. Foster a collaborative and creative environment among music teams.

2. 7 Budget and Resource Management Work within allocated budgets for music production. Manage expenses related to musicians, studio time, instruments, and equipment. Ensure efficient use of musical resources without compromising quality.

2. 8 Live Performance Direction Conduct orchestras or musical groups during live performances. Ensure synchronization between musicians, performers, and technical teams. Adapt musical direction dynamically during live shows when needed.

2. 9 Music Licensing and Rights Ensure proper licensing for music usage when necessary. Coordinate with legal teams regarding copyright compliance. Manage publishing and rights agreements related to musical compositions.

3. Required Qualifications - Education Bachelor's degree in Music, Music Composition, Music Production, or a related field. A master's degree in music or conducting is considered an advantage. - Professional Experience Minimum 5-10 years of professional experience in music composition, directing, or production. Experience leading musicians or ensembles in professional environments. Demonstrated success in managing musical projects from concept to execution. - Technical Skills The Music Director should possess expertise in: Music theory and composition Instrumentation and orchestration Conducting techniques Music production and recording Digital audio workstations (DAWs) such as: Logic Pro Pro Tools Ableton Live Cubase Additional familiarity with sound design, mixing, and mastering is beneficial.

4. Key Competencies - Artistic Vision The Music Director must have the ability to conceptualize and execute a cohesive musical identity for projects. This includes selecting styles, instruments, and arrangements that best convey artistic intent. - Leadership and Team Management Ability to inspire and motivate musicians and performers. Strong communication and collaboration skills. Capability to manage diverse creative teams effectively. - Creative Problem-Solving Music production often presents unexpected challenges. The Music Director must quickly develop solutions to musical, technical, or performance issues. - Attention to Detail Musical excellence requires precision in timing, harmony, instrumentation, and sound quality. - Adaptability Music Directors frequently work in dynamic environments such as live performances, recording studios, or multimedia productions. The ability to adapt to changing creative needs is essential.

5. Tools and Technology Music Directors commonly work with the following tools: - Music Production Software Digital Audio Workstations (DAWs) MIDI sequencing software Audio editing tools - Studio Equipment Mixing consoles Microphones and recording hardware Audio monitoring systems - Notation Software Sibelius Finale MuseScore

6. Work Environment Music Directors may work in various environments depending on the organization or project, including: Recording studios Concert halls Film or television production studios Music production companies Performing arts organizations Media production environments The role may involve irregular working hours, especially when preparing for live performances, recordings, or production deadlines.

7. Performance Metrics A Music Director's performance is often evaluated based on: Quality of musical productions Audience and critical reception Efficiency in managing rehearsals and productions Collaboration effectiveness with creative teams Adherence to budgets and production timelines

8. Career Growth Opportunities Professionals in this role may advance to positions such as: Senior Music Director Artistic Director Head of Music Production Film Score Composer * Music Producer With significant experience, Music Directors may also establish independent music production companies or pursue careers in film scoring, orchestral conducting, or large-scale entertainment productions.

9. Equal Opportunity Statement Our organization is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives who share a passion for musical excellence and creative collaboration.

# Job Description - Music Director & Composer

**Position:** Music Director / Composer
**Location:** Mumbai, Maharashtra, India (Hybrid / On-site)
**Employment Type:** Full-time | Contract | Project-based
**Industry:** Film & Entertainment / Music Production / Digital Media
**Experience Required:** 10-15 years
**Posted by:** Route

---

## About the Role

We are looking for a highly skilled and creatively driven **Music Director & Composer** to lead the musical vision of our upcoming film/digital/brand projects. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in **Hindustani classical tradition** combined with a strong command of **contemporary music production**, enabling them to craft emotionally resonant, culturally rooted, and commercially appealing soundscapes.

This role demands both artistic leadership and technical execution - from conceptualizing the sonic identity of a project to supervising final mix deliverables. The Music Director will work closely with directors, producers, lyricists, and artists to deliver world-class musical output across film scores, original songs, and background music.

## Key Responsibilities

### Creative & Compositional

* Conceptualize and develop the complete musical identity of assigned projects (films, OTT series, ad campaigns, or live productions)
* Compose original songs, background scores, and thematic motifs aligned with the project's narrative and emotional arc
* Integrate classical Indian raga frameworks with contemporary production styles (electronic, jazz, orchestral, fusion) where appropriate
* Write or co-write lyrics in Hindi and/or Urdu for original compositions when required
* Develop leitmotifs and recurring musical themes that serve the storytelling

### Production & Studio

* Direct and supervise studio recording sessions for vocalists, instrumentalists, and session musicians
* Produce music end-to-end using DAWs (**Ableton Live**, **Logic Pro X**, or equivalent)
* Collaborate with sound engineers and mixing/mastering professionals to deliver broadcast-ready audio
* Oversee sound design for background score and ambient soundscapes
* Manage multi-track session files, stems, and archival deliverables

### Team & Artist Management

* Identify, shortlist, and brief playback singers, session musicians, and orchestrators
* Provide vocal direction and artistic guidance to performers in the studio
* Coordinate with lyricists, choreographers, and directors to align musical compositions with visual sequences
* Manage project timelines, recording schedules, and music delivery deadlines

### Collaboration & Communication

* Work closely with film directors, executive producers, and creative heads to align musical direction with overall project vision
* Present compositions and mood references in pre-production meetings
* Incorporate feedback iteratively while maintaining creative integrity
* Liaise with music labels, licensing teams, and rights management departments as needed

## Required Qualifications

### Education

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Music (Hindustani Classical, Composition, or equivalent) from a recognized institution
* Formal classical training under a recognized Gharana or equivalent gurukul experience is strongly preferred
* Certification or coursework in music production / audio engineering is an advantage

### Experience

* Minimum **10 years** of professional experience in music composition, direction, or production
* Demonstrated experience as a **Music Director or Lead Composer** on at least 5 film/OTT/commercial projects
* Proven track record of independently producing and releasing original music with measurable audience reach
* Experience directing studio sessions and managing musicians in a professional recording environment

## Technical Skills

* Advanced proficiency in **Ableton Live** and/or **Logic Pro X**
* Strong knowledge of MIDI composition, orchestration, and digital audio workflows
* Familiarity with notation systems - Bhatkhande (Indian) and Western staff notation
* Understanding of audio post-production workflows (stem delivery, sync licensing formats)

## Musical Expertise

* Deep knowledge of **Hindustani classical ragas** across all time categories and seasons
* Strong command of **taal cycles** and rhythmic frameworks (Teentaal, Ektaal, Rupak, etc.)
* Versatility across genres: classical, sufi/qawwali, contemporary Bollywood, indie/fusion, folk
* Ability to compose melodically and harmonically for both traditional and modern arrangements

## Preferred Qualifications

* Experience scoring for **independent or feature films** screened at national or international film festivals
* Prior collaboration with established Bollywood music directors or production houses
* Active discography with streaming presence on Spotify, JioSaavn, YouTube Music, or equivalent
* International performance or touring experience
* Familiarity with **IPRS/PPL** rights registration and music licensing frameworks in India
* Existing network of session musicians, studios, and music professionals in Mumbai

## What We're Looking For - Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal Music Director for this role is someone who:

* Has been trained in the classical tradition but is equally at home in a modern production studio
* Can bridge the emotional depth of Indian classical music with the sonic demands of contemporary media
* Is an effective communicator who can articulate musical ideas to non-musical collaborators (directors, producers, brand teams)
* Is self-driven with a strong portfolio of original work and a recognizable artistic voice
* Has demonstrated the ability to lead creative teams and deliver under production timelines
* Is passionate about pushing the boundaries of Indian music while remaining deeply respectful of its roots

---

## Compensation & Benefits

* Competitive project fee / monthly retainer (commensurate with experience)
* Royalty participation on released compositions (IPRS registered)
* Full creative credit on all associated projects
* Access to premium studio facilities in Mumbai
* Flexible work schedule with defined project milestones
* Opportunity to build long-term association with an established production entity

## How to Apply

Interested candidates are requested to share the following:

1. **Updated Resume / Artist Bio**
2. **Portfolio / Showreel** - links to original compositions, film scores, or released work
3. **Brief Cover Note** (200-300 words) - outlining your compositional approach and why this role excites you
4. **References** - at least 2 professional references from the music/film industry

☑ Send applications to: careers@[companyname].com
Or apply via: [www.route.com/careers](www.route.com/careers)

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. We encourage applications from artists across all backgrounds and musical traditions.

Here are a few **ready-to-use versions** depending on the type of company. You can choose the one that fits your JD.

## Generic Version (Best if company details are unknown)

### About Route

Route is a creative production company focused on delivering high-quality storytelling across music, film, and digital platforms. The team collaborates with artists, brands, and creators to develop compelling audio-visual experiences that resonate with modern audiences. With a strong emphasis on creativity, innovation, and collaboration, Route works across projects such as music videos, branded content, digital campaigns, and original productions, aiming to push creative boundaries while maintaining high production standards.

---

## OTT / Media Studio Version

### About Route

Route is a forward-thinking media and content production studio dedicated to creating impactful stories for streaming platforms and digital audiences. The company collaborates with filmmakers, musicians, and brands to produce original content including web series, music productions, branded storytelling, and digital-first experiences. With a strong creative vision and a commitment to high production quality, Route focuses on crafting narratives that connect with global audiences.

---

## Music Label / Creative Studio Version

### About Route

Route is a creative music and media studio that supports artists, composers, and creators in producing original music and audio-visual content. The company works across music production, film scoring, digital campaigns, and artist collaborations, helping bring innovative ideas to life. By combining artistic excellence with modern production techniques, Route aims to amplify unique voices and deliver memorable experiences for audiences worldwide.

MS SQL Server Developer (Azure, DevOps, GIT)



Full-time

Location: Fully Remote


JOIN A TEAM THAT EMPOWERS YOU



Eracent stands at the forefront of IT Asset Management (ITAM) and Software Asset Management (SAM) solutions, designed to help organizations optimize their IT assets, reduce costs, and ensure regulatory compliance. Our flagship product, ITPedia®, serves as a comprehensive knowledge base, providing detailed information on millions of software and hardware products. As we continue to enhance our solutions with cloud and data-driven capabilities, we are seeking an experienced MS SQL Server Developer to join our growing team in India. In this position, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining SQL Server databases, supporting DevOps workflows, and integrating Azure-based solutions that drive our global data operations.


ROLE PURPOSE



As an MS SQL Server Developer, you will design and optimize SQL Server databases, ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability. You will collaborate with development and DevOps teams to implement CI/CD pipelines, support cloud migrations, and ensure that data processes meet performance and security requirements. This role requires hands-on experience with SQL Server development, Azure, and Git-based version control systems.


KEY FOCUS



* Design, develop, and maintain SQL Server databases, stored procedures, functions, and triggers.

* Optimize database performance through indexing strategies, query tuning, and refactoring.

* Implement DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines for database deployment (Azure DevOps preferred).

* Collaborate with developers and data engineers to support data integration and transformation processes.

* Administer Azure SQL Databases, configure backups, and monitor performance metrics.

* Work with Git for version control and database change tracking.

* Ensure data security, compliance, and high availability in production environments.

* Participate in architecture reviews and propose improvements to database design and automation workflows.


COMPETENCIES:



* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

* 5+ years of professional experience in SQL Server database development and optimization.

* Advanced knowledge of T-SQL, indexing, query optimization, and schema design.

* Experience with Azure SQL Database, Azure Data Services, or related cloud technologies.

* Proficiency in DevOps CI/CD tools (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar).

* Experience with Git-based workflows for version control.

* Understanding of database backup, restore, and high-availability strategies.

* Strong understanding of data modeling and relational design principles.

* Good English communication skills, both written and spoken.


EXPERIENCE, CAPABILITIES AND BEHAVIORS:



Must have professional/ technical qualifications


* Experience with Azure DevOps pipelines or GitHub Actions for database automation.

* Familiarity with PowerShell or Python scripting for automation is a plus.

* Understanding of data governance and security standards.

* Microsoft certifications such as Azure Database Administrator Associate or Azure Data Engineer Associate are advantageous.

* Experience with IT Asset Management (ITAM) or Software Asset Management (SAM) solutions is a plus.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

* Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.

* Self-motivated and able to work independently or collaboratively within a distributed team.

* Adaptable to changing requirements and technologies.

* Commitment to continuous learning and process improvement.

Registered Nurse / Staff Nurse

🇬🇧 UK (NHS & Private Hospitals) | 🇩🇪 Germany | 🇦🇪 UAE | 🇸🇦 Saudi Arabia | 🇶🇦 Qatar | 🇰🇼 Kuwait

Platform: JobsifyAI — International Care Hub

Function: Clinical Nursing | Hospital & Community Settings

Candidate Profile: INC-registered nurses with 2+ years post-qualification experience

Language: English (UK/Middle East) | German B1/B2 preferred (Germany)

Employment Type: Full-Time | Permanent | Sponsored Visa Roles Available

Note: 🌟 One of the most in-demand international healthcare roles globally — Indian nurses are among the most recruited worldwide



About the Role

Indian nurses are globally respected for their clinical competence, work ethic, and compassion — and demand for Indian RNs has never been higher. The UK's NHS, Germany's hospital system, and Gulf-based hospitals and clinics are actively seeking experienced staff nurses across all specialties. This is your pathway to a sponsored, well-paid, internationally recognized nursing career with genuine long-term residency and growth prospects in your chosen destination.



Key Responsibilities

  1. Deliver direct patient care — assessment, care planning, implementation, and evaluation within your ward or unit
  2. Administer medications, IV therapy, wound care, and clinical procedures as per protocols
  3. Monitor patient conditions and escalate changes to senior medical staff promptly
  4. Maintain accurate clinical documentation and nursing records
  5. Educate patients and families on care plans, discharge instructions, and health management
  6. Collaborate with the multidisciplinary team — doctors, physiotherapists, OTs, social workers
  7. Adhere to infection control, safeguarding, and professional nursing standards of the destination country's nursing council
  8. Mentor junior staff and student nurses where applicable



✅ Must Have

  1. B.Sc Nursing or GNM from a recognized Indian institution, registered with the Indian Nursing Council (INC) and State Nursing Council
  2. Minimum 2–3 years of post-qualification clinical experience (hospital-based preferred)
  3. IELTS 7.0+ or OET B for UK NHS roles | IELTS 6.0–6.5+ for Middle East | German B1 minimum for Germany
  4. Current, valid INC registration certificate
  5. Strong clinical skills — IV cannulation, catheterization, wound care, vital sign monitoring
  6. Clean professional record — no disciplinary actions or fitness to practice concerns



⭐ Nice to Have

  1. Specialty experience — ICU/CCU, A&E/ER, Paediatrics, OT/Theatre, Oncology, Dialysis, or Maternity
  2. NMC (UK) OSCE completion or enrolled in NMC CBT preparation — dramatically reduces UK onboarding time
  3. German language B2 or higher
  4. HAAD, DHA, MOH (UAE), SCFHS (Saudi), or QCHP (Qatar) registration or eligibility letter
  5. Postgraduate clinical certifications (BLS, ACLS, PALS, etc.)
  6. Prior international nursing experience or training
  7. Leadership experience — charge nurse, team leader, or ward in-charge responsibilities
